desc:
🥐 Welcome to My Bakery Cafe!
Start with a small bakery and grow it into your dream café! Bake fresh conchas, brew coffee, and serve customers to earn bakery cash and build your reputation.
☕ Unlock new breads and drinks as you serve more customers.
🔥 Upgrade your ovens, displays, and kitchen.
🪑 Add tables, open your patio, and expand upstairs!
🍽️ Carry multiple orders with a serving tray.
🎨 Pick your colors and make your bakery your own.
🤝 Invite a friend in your server to help—choose free help or share customer earnings!
👩‍🍳 Hire staff to help with baking, dishes, and restocking.
🛒 Stock up on baking supplies at the market.
⭐ Earn great reviews and compete for Bakery of the Day!

Play solo or bake together. Your dream bakery starts here!

🛠️ BETA — We’re still improving! Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback.
